 Inspiration 

 WebMCP enables a lot of use cases. But I think interactive games is a particularly unique use case as it lets AI directly control in game state without requiring any additional configuration. Here AI can roleplay as a character or object and add an extra layer of depth by handling information the human cannot see. 

 What it does 

 An interactive game that requires you and your AI to work together. 

 What's next for Maintenance Required 

 More puzzles, more tool, more ship ;)
